response.sql: WITH hand_counts AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.bats), ''), '(blank)') AS bats_hand, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM fielding f LEFT JOIN player p ON p.player_id = f.player_id GROUP BY 1), totals AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total, AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM hand_counts) SELECT h.bats_hand AS bats, h.cnt AS count, CAST(h.cnt AS REAL) / t.total AS share, h.cnt - t.avg_cnt AS above_avg FROM hand_counts h CROSS JOIN totals t WHERE h.cnt > t.avg_cnt;
